panels.title: 文件描述符汇总

targets.expr:
sum(
  group (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", created_by_kind="StatefulSet", created_by_name="$statefulset"}) by (pod)
  * on(pod) 
  max by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",container!="",image!="",container!="POD"}[5m]))
)

sum(
  group (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", created_by_kind="StatefulSet", created_by_name="$statefulset"}) by (pod)
  * on(pod) 
  max by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="",image!="", container!="POD"})
)
